_note: ArUco calibration for ingest. Defined by docs/02-dataset-spec.md §1.1 - this file carries the rig convention as values, it does not define the rule. Recorded in every data/calib/<session_id>.json.
_corner_rule_note: See docs/02-dataset-spec.md §1.1 for the rule and why the marker centre and the outer corner are both wrong.
_nominal_corner_index_note: What the innermost rule EVALUATES TO on the nominal zenithal rig: index into the marker's detectMarkers quad (TL, TR, BR, BL). Not the selection rule - src/calibrate.py selects geometrically, then compares with this and reports a divergence. A divergence means a marker is taped on rotated or the plate is turned within the frame; both are legitimate, so it is a flag in data/ingest_report.json, never an error.
